company.name: FlowEQ
company.shortDescription: AI: AgentLess or AgentLed, FlowEQ streamlines agent behavior, optimizing customer experience
company.description: FlowEQ is the trusted provider of workflow automation for teams that need to accelerate their work, especially complex processes and high-volume workflows that require human judgment, expertise or empathy at key moments. The FlowEQ Workflow Acceleration Platform includes interactive decision trees that are used by customer support, operations and product teams across all industries to improve accuracy and speed up important recurring work. Using FlowEQ customers get through high-stake recurring workflows 10x faster, saving their companies time and money every day. For additional information, visit https://www.floweq.com.

productsAndServices.description: A no-code workflow automation platform that embeds within existing CRM systems to streamline and accelerate recurring work through interactive decision trees and automated backend actions.
productsAndServices.name: FlowEQ Process Acceleration Platform

productsAndServices.description: Integrations with platforms like Airtable, Google Sheets, and GitHub to track product quality issues and synchronize data within customer support workflows.
productsAndServices.name: FlowEQ Data and Quality Tracking Integrations

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,895,000, or 96.89% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,086,798 to $19,075,023, a 6.18x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
